title: Short Stories in Italian for Beginners
author: Daily Italian with Elena
description: Simple Italian stories for beginners with text in Italian. In this serie of videos I will read a short and simple story in Italian very slowly. You can follow my voice and read the text in Italian on the screen. If you want to find the free TRANSCRIPTION and TRANSLATION of this video or if you just want to say thank you with a coffee, visit my Patreon page: https://www.patreon.com/dailyitalianwithelena On YouTube, you can watch the video with English subtitles: https://youtube.com/playlist?list=PLoJZJvy-jQPUjgNPVSz3vRs8us686zh7X&si=wPLQPgzV9wCkNIJN I hope you like it!
